mechanismAssessment.recommendation: Implement the complete two-skill ordinary general next; do not omit allocation or off-turn basic use directions.
reusable: GameEngine.MouLuMeng.cs BeginRoundForTurn: actual round lifecycle, excluding extra turns; ProgramBasicCardName supplies Slash canonicalization.
Positive-input native hand conversion supports material payment and use-qualified Dodge/Peach/Alcohol/forced true Slash paths; retain native Use versus pure Response classification.
GameEngine.RuleQueries.cs uses base rule candidates separately from additive contributions, suitable for a new assigned-default baseline.
Existing native DamageFrame and completed positive applied facts can establish distinct off-turn damage occurrences.
newRequired: A turn-owned four-item numeric multiset and four assigned default slots, selected at Draw/Play/Discard stage boundaries, with skipped/extra phase behavior and cold typed continuations.
A pending-next-actual-turn minimum-increment ledger tied to actual damage occurrences and stable owning source/state.

An additive two-same-color-basic conversion family with owner+stable method+actual round+normalized name issuance ledger; existing tieredRoundConversion schema requires one/zero input and cannot represent two inputs.
Input acceptance, legal prompt publication, true Use-only response and dying rescues, unique material payment, cold restore and source-loss semantics must be verified.
notReusableAsIs: TieredRoundConversionSchema.cs requires InputCount=1 at tiers0/1 or0 at tier2 and coupled tier-specific phase/round quotas.
ProgramTieredRoundConversion.TrueRoundHasUsedName is global all-use history, whereas YiLie excludes only this owner-method issued names.
DrawFundedDistinctBasicPolicy charges Draw1 and uses actual-turn quota; YiLie is physical pair cost and actual-round name quota.

directClientBehaviorEvidence.allocationChoices: awi.GetResponser sets flag=server.Param-1. GetMultiSelectDatas enumerates positive values supplied in server.Params and sends the chosen numeric value. Four prompt indexes CARD/ATTACK/SHA/LIMIT are0/1/2/3. This demonstrates one property selection per request, not the hidden server phase scheduling algorithm.
directClientBehaviorEvidence.rangeBaseline: Client range recomputation offset20301350 compares DATA_SHANDUAN_RANGE with weapon/native baseline using u>i&&(i=u), then applies other state and character additive range contributions. Assigned range is a baseline floor, not replacement of weapon range or additive +value.
directClientBehaviorEvidence.useOnly: GBi sets cardUseType=UCt.USE; off-turn Activated rejects current TriggerCardUseType=UCt.DEAL. Pure Duel/Barbarian Slash and Arrow Dodge responses are excluded.
directClientBehaviorEvidence.rescue: GBi.Activated explicitly checks Peach ask targets and self Alcohol availability; rescue uses remain part of the skill.
directClientBehaviorEvidence.normalizedSlash: GBi.UpdateRoleDataResponse suppresses Slash and all fire/thunder/ice/Qinglong variants together when server used-name data contains SHA. Dodge, Peach and Alcohol have separate names.
directClientBehaviorEvidence.woodenOx: GBi.requestCardType=NORMAL|MUNIULIUMA and eligibility scans own HandCards plus GetSkillOutsideCards(MUNIULIUMA_JIEXIANTUPO). This is native stored-grain hand-like use behavior, not arbitrary Equipment permission.

officialFaqAudit.result: No primary official专项FAQ resolving repeated minimum increases, ties, skipped stages or exact round boundary was located in this bounded search. Official current hero and two2022 posts repeat the same skill rule. Public client presents server-provided choices and does not implement the hidden allocation/increase scheduler.
officialFaqAudit.absenceScope: A bounded negative result, not a claim that no officialFAQ exists anywhere. Other candidates were not given an exhaustiveFAQ audit.

engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.approvalState: Proposed complete engine mapping, pending final root capability contract; direct public-client facts are separately identified above.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.allocation: Initialize one fresh actual-owner-turn pool[1,2,3,4], with queued off-turn damage adjustments. Draw-start selects one remaining entry for normal Draw baseline; Play-start selects distinct remaining entries for attack-range baseline and Slash-use baseline; Discard-start selects the remaining entry for hand-limit baseline. No phase reinitializes the whole pool.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.minimumIncrease: One increment per separate positive applied out-turn damage occurrence, regardless of damage amount. Repeatedly increment one currently minimum entry in the pending next-turn pool using a stable tie slot; do not increment every tied minimum at once. This tie/cumulative rule is not established by an officialFAQ.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.expiry: Consume queued pending next-turn increments on the next actual owner turn, including an extra actual turn; unused or skipped slots expire with that turn. This is not a permanent pool upgrade.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.skippedAndExtraPhases: Skipped stages do not consume their allocation slots. An extra same-turn Play uses the existing assigned defaults and cannot rebuild or double-consume the pool. Final detailed behavior when skipped stages leave extra choices is a root implementation mapping.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.range: Verified client behavior: max(native weapon-or-base range, assigned default range), followed by normal additive range modifiers.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.nameQuota: Sameowner+stablemethodledgerId+actualRoundNumber+normalizedName, only accepted real method uses consume; Slash variants share Slash. Physical source loss/regrant and extra phase/extra turn do not reset the same actual round quota.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.useDirections: Actual Play basic uses, native own Slash-Dodge Use, real forced actual Slash Use, healthy rescue Peach and own Dying Peach/Alcohol are eligible. Pure response-only Duel/Barbarian Slash, Arrow Dodge and faction supply do not become YiLie Use. Public client directly distinguishes USE/DEAL; exact native mapping follows engine boundaries.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.roundBoundary: Reuse established native actual RoundStarted lifecycle; this policy is an explicit engine mapping because no new officialFAQ defining round boundaries was found.
engineMappingProposalsNotOfficialQuotes.woodenOx: Current public client recognizes WoodenOx stored grain in normal hand-like card selection. Existing native grain producer must be retained where already supported, not silently reclassified as arbitrary equipment or omitted without reporting.
